Products procured by Central/State Government Departments for implementation of schemes are of right quality and adhere to Indian Standards. Wherever there are certain processes/services involved, the executive departments follow right code of practices. In case of certain products/processes/services for which Indian Standards are not available; such gap areas are identified in timely manner and respective technical committees can take up the matter for formulation of standards on such areas. Standards and quality culture is imbibed in central/state government departments across all levels, as adherence to Indian Standards fosters a culture of quality and reliability within government departments. For future schemes/missions government departments can proactively get involved with BIS for providing the necessary assistance pertaining to standardization needs related to upcoming schemes/missions. With the mapping exercise BIS aims to contribute further towards a more effective and efficient implementation of various schemes/missions run by government and to imbibe quality culture across all levels where these schemes are making an impact.
